problem: Help our support team answer faster

functional.text: Draft a first reply within one working minute of a ticket arriving
Sort each ticket into one of four queues
Draft a reply that cites the right policy
Never send a reply without a person approving it

infrastructure.latency: Draft ready within a few seconds, measured from the support office
infrastructure.scale: Peak load at the busiest hour of the week

residency.rule: Client contract: customer data processed in India

infrastructure.identity: Runs under a service role; every draft and approval is logged
